business_summary.text: Pennar Industries is an industrial manufacturing company with focus on PEB (Pre-Engineered Buildings), engineering services, boilers, and BIW (Body-in-White) components, with significant presence in India and US markets.

call_points.text: FY27 capex at ₹100 Cr for BIW Hyundai plant completion and automation; to be funded through cash generation
Order backlog healthy at ₹900 Cr; PEB India expected to grow double-digit in FY27
Labor issues resolved; automation being deployed to address future labor concerns

guidance.statement: Working capital days target for next quarters
Debt-equity ratio target by end of FY27

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Industrial Products

operating_notes.text: PEB India capacity utilization at 70%, target to reach 80% in FY27
Labor issues resolved; automation being deployed to address future labor concerns
Solar revenue impacted Q4 diversified business performance
PEB India order book at ₹1,008 Cr (record high)
PEB US order backlog crossed USD 100 million
Boiler order book at ₹150.75 Cr (highest ever)

timeline.summary: Pennar Industries Limited held Q4FY26 results conference call on 27th May 2026, committing to 20% PAT growth for FY27 with continued margin expansion
Pennar Industries Q1FY27 results: Revenue ₹884.55 Cr (+3.6% YoY), PBT ₹46.8 Cr (+16% YoY), EBITDA ₹106.8 Cr (+13.3% YoY); record order book at ₹1,008 Cr for PEB India and USD 100M for PEB US

watchlist.response: Focused on reducing working capital days to 75 in the next few quarters by improving inventory turns and collecting receivables
watchlist.text: Increase in working capital days to 82 days due to inventory and receivables buildup

watchlist.response: Target to reduce to 0.8x by end of FY27 through profitability, equity infusion, and cash generation
Investment in US operations capabilities for future growth, expected to justify with double-digit revenue growth in US business
watchlist.text: Employee cost growing faster than profitability (16% vs 3.6% revenue growth)
